screeningSummary: Retired school principal demands the show be taken off the air - says airing sightings 'draws them in' and her schoolchildren stopped sleeping
arcNotes: Opinion caller, no sighting, sincere and bureaucratic. Vern shares the media-panic history and concedes the open line is the point. Ends on a soft truce
